content.title: Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court | United States
content.text: Skip to main content Public Filings » The Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court was established by Congress in 1978. The Court entertains applications made by the United States Government for approval of electronic surveillance, physical search, and certain other forms of investigative actions for foreign intelligence purposes.
